items.title: Art Dealer Sentenced for Falsely Claiming Native Heritage
items.summary: Jose Martinez adopted the name Joseph Skywolf and ran a traveling gallery that sold products falsely marketed as Native, violating the Indian Arts and Crafts Act.

items.title: Native Artist Receives $10K Grant to Revive Visor Craftmaking
items.summary: Dustin Newman (Unangax̂/Deg Hit’an Athabascan) will use the Walker Youngbird Foundation grant to revive the qayaatx̂ux, or chief visor.

items.title: Richard Powell Unsettles Race and Color Theory
items.summary: Drawing on the work of artists and theorists alike, the art historian traces how generations of Black painters have deployed color and how color, in turn, shapes our understanding of Blackness.
